messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER -> Ingress gateway (api-gateway-prod) reporting elevated 502/504 rate across eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Alert threshold crossed: 6m rolling error rate 7%. Pager: laura-oncall.
laura-oncall: I'm on it. kicking off triage. anyone seeing related deploys?
ryan-eng: no recent safe deploys in the last hour on api-gateway. I see CPU on the mux-proxy nodes spiking.
mike-eng-sre: adding logs from edge proxy:
```
[2026-03-17T02:14:12Z] upstream read timeout (504) for /v1/gen
[2026-03-17T02:14:13Z] 502 Bad Gateway from mux-proxy-3 -> model-pool-2
```

sam-platform: traffic pattern shows sudden fanout to eu model pool due to client replay. qps doubled for certain routes.
emily-telemetry: dashboards: 502s concentrated on POST /v1/chat, median latency for successful requests +120ms. customer impact: increased error rate for interactive endpoints, a few high-tier customers reporting failures. see link: https://telemetry.redwood.internal/d/ingress/502-heatmap
laura-oncall: first mitigations: 1) enable ingress retry-circuiting for problematic routes 2) shift a small % of traffic away from eu-west region to us-east fallback pool 3) scale up edge-proxy ASG by +2 nodes. doing now.
anish-routing: leaning on autoscaler but will manually kick extra nodes. also flip mux-proxy to degrade heavy fanout routes: set header `x-rw-degrade: true`.
mike-eng-sre: rolling a temporary policy:
```
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/api/v1/route-control \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/chat","action":"circuit_break","threshold":0.05}'
```
laura-oncall: ops-bot, run customer-impact rollup and notify CSM if >5% error for 15m
ops-bot: runbook triggered: sending webhook to csm-notify, creating incident timeline doc.
ryan-eng: quick check of upstreams: model-pool-2 pods have OOMs starting 02:12Z, maybe a model checkpoint job?
emily-telemetry: correlation: model-pool-2 memory usage rose sharply at 02:10Z, pod restarts increased. looks like inference worker memory leak/pressure.
sam-platform: suggestion: pin traffic away from model-pool-2 and route to model-pool-4 (quantized) with lower memory footprint. Might increase latency slightly but reduce 502s.
anish-routing: initiating gradual reroute 10% -> 50% to pool-4 now. watch for latency regressions.
mike-eng-sre: confirming edge scaling done, new proxies online. 502 rate dropping from 7% -> 3.2% in last 3m.
laura-oncall: good. still monitoring. action items: - SRE to investigate pool-2 pod OOMs - ML infra to check recent model builds/rollouts - Platform to keep reroute until pool-2 healthy - CSM on standby for customer comms
ryan-eng: capturing current logs and opening issue: https://issues.redwood.internal/INC-2026-modelpool2-oom
emily-telemetry: customer-impact summary: ~12 customers affected intermittently, top 3 experienced ~15-25% error spikes; overall 0.8% of total requests failed customer-facing (post-mitigation).
laura-oncall: moving to mitigation phase. paging to oncall-sre for deeper debug: @mike-eng-sre you own next steps.
mike-eng-sre: I'll debug worker memory footprint, dump heap from a restarted pod, and check for recent model uploads.
anish-routing: keeping reroute in place, will rollback to normal when pool-2 stabilizes for 20m.
sam-platform: will throttle background model sampling to reduce fanout.
laura-oncall: thanks team. continuing watch. will post an update in 15. :white_check_mark:
incidents-bot: Incident timeline entry created: incident-id INC-2026-2918273645. Severity: P2.
laura-oncall: UPDATE (15m): 502 rate steady ~0.9%. pool-2 memory leak reproduced in dev; ML infra rolling a fix. keeping reroute until patch lands. prepping postmortem notes.
